resume.about: Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer specializing in PHP, Java, MySQL, and custom WordPress (_s). I build scalable, optimized, and custom web solutions.

job.description: Software Engineer working primarily in PHP, building custom enterprise software solutions end-to-end. Developed modules for a proprietary ERP (Horión Enterprise) with a multi-tenant PHP architecture and custom router pattern, including a full email outbox module (sent email history with filters and pagination, binary attachment download from database, and resend with new file uploads) and binary output buffering — plus legacy frontend support in vanilla JS with MooTools.

Custom web architecture and Full Stack solutions prioritizing extreme performance (WPO), scalability, and user experience. Built Zalbi Aisia (custom WordPress CMS with CPTs, taxonomic filtering, Polylang i18n, CI/CD via Webhooks) and yeraygarrido.dev (React 19 SPA, 100/100 Lighthouse, GSAP animations, GDPR-compliant cookie system).

Developed two Contact Form 7 extensions from scratch: a CSV Exporter with data sanitization and a DB Persistence system with MySQL storage and admin viewer. Server migration management, automated backups, security auditing, and UI/UX prototyping in Figma.
Maintenance and update of the organization website, ensuring correct content display and structure.
